research_question: Does one-week cross-sectional momentum persist across liquid Binance USDT perpetuals after causal universe construction and realistic turnover costs?
hypothesis: Crypto relative strength persists over short horizons; assets with the strongest prior 7-day returns outperform the weakest over the next 7 days.
economic_mechanism: Gradual information diffusion, speculative capital rotation, and under-reaction can create short-horizon cross-sectional continuation in crypto.

signal.schedule: Monday 00:00 UTC signal; execute next hourly open
signal.weighting: equal weight within each leg; 0.5 gross long + 0.5 gross short
signal.position_rule: long highest trailing 168h return quartile; short lowest quartile

execution.funding: not modeled separately; robustness includes additional carry-drag sensitivity and this omission blocks manual-confirmation promotion if material

validation.primary_metric: net OOS annualized Sharpe from daily-equivalent portfolio equity returns
factor_diagnostics: cross-sectional rank IC at weekly rebalance
robustness: neighbor formation 120h and 240h as preregistered sensitivity

kill_criteria.factor_gate: mean weekly rank IC <= 0 or unstable sign in most OOS years
kill_criteria.strategy_gate: net OOS Sharpe <= 0.5 or <=0 under 2x costs
kill_criteria.concentration_gate: Sharpe collapses below 0.5 after strongest asset removal

labels: forward 168h open-to-open holding return for diagnostics/backtest
notes: No feature-catalog sweep. Formation horizon and neighboring 120h/240h checks are pre-registered before results.
